sources.name: Broader frontage evidence
sources.detail: Twelve additional frontages use region-specific openings, material transitions, raised entries, arched glazing, projecting bays and observed lettering. Undated owner photographs and estimated long-wall counts remain marked as uncertain.

sources.name: Articulated building envelopes
sources.date: Jan 2025 street view + historic detail photos
sources.detail: Beacon, Glassworks and Oracle Park decomposed into separate wings, projecting surfaces, cores, roof profiles and open structures. Image annotations constrain bounded LiDAR level fits; depth is still estimated.

sources.name: USGS LiDAR
sources.detail: 4.6 million sampled points; ground elevations and fitted roof tiers. Absolute accuracy has not been independently tested.

sources.name: DataSF building footprints
sources.detail: Building outlines reconciled against current OpenStreetMap identities and newer LiDAR heights.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.detail: Address identity, newer buildings, road topology, lane counts, crossings and transit tracks. Capture age varies.

sources.name: DataSF street trees
sources.detail: Mapped tree positions and species. Canopies and branches are procedural.

sources.name: Distinct facade surface families
sources.detail: Fine-jointed brick, smooth trim, stucco, ribbed terracotta and opaque metal panels use separate metric recipes. Asphalt/concrete retain CC0 scans. Exact colors and wear remain approximate.

sources.name: Hotel exterior photography
sources.detail: Operator and structural engineer photographs fit bay stacks, terracotta fields and external shades. Historical layouts need current independent checks.

sources.name: Mapillary coverage
sources.detail: Dense capture coverage is visible around King and Third. Individual images and their capture dates have not been ingested in this pass.

sources.name: Street-level reference
sources.detail: Sparse image landmarks and visual grammars distinguish loft terraces, continuous glazing and separate ground-floor patterns. Source pixels are not embedded.

updateSummary: Every layer regenerated from the current general rules in one run; no geometry carried over from earlier builds. Facade source coverage remains incomplete.
